values.meaning: base magic damage of a Sand Soldier's attack against the primary target
level-based bonus magic damage added to the Sand Soldier's attack
values.quote: {{pplevel|0; then +8*x|1;10+(x-1)|formula=0 at level 1, then +8 per level starting at level 10}}
values.binNote: The wiki's leveling2 row lists this level-based bonus as part of the total damage formula, but the sheet's AzirW#TotalDamage calculation only reads BaseDamage and APRatio - it has no byLevelL term for this additive component. No data value in the AzirW slot carries these numbers; the bin appears to be missing this term (or it is computed elsewhere not shown in this sheet).

values.meaning: percentage of the attack's damage dealt to targets hit beyond the closest one in the line
values.quote: {{pp|20; then +8*x for 10|1;9 to 18|formula=20% at level 1, then +8% per level starting at level 9 and capped at level 18|key=%}}
values.binNote: Bin's byLevelL array reaches 1.0 (100%) at level 18 (index 17), one level later than the wiki's listed values which cap growth at level 18 too; values through level 17 match, level 18 also matches (0.92 wiki vs 0.92... actually bin shows 1 at index 17/level18) - minor discrepancy at level 18 (bin 1.0 vs wiki implies continued +0.08 series would be 1.0 as well, so they agree).

values.meaning: damage percentage of subsequent Sand Soldier attacks against the same target (without on-hit/on-attack effects)
values.quote: Subsequent {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} attacks against the same target deal 25% damage without applying {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.

values.meaning: on-hit and on-attack effect effectiveness applied by a Sand Soldier's attack on the primary target
values.quote: the {{as|Sand Soldier's|buzzword2}} attack applies both {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, the damage of which is reduced to 50% effectiveness

values.meaning: duration a Sand Soldier persists after being summoned

mechanics.claim: Azir's basic attacks against enemies within a soldier's range are replaced by the soldier's spear-thrust attack instead of Azir's own attack.
mechanics.quote: summons a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} against enemies within their range

mechanics.claim: The soldier's attack is a line attack that can hit multiple enemies, dealing area damage; only the primary target's instance is tagged as basic damage and receives on-hit/on-attack effects.
mechanics.quote: thrusting their spear in the target's direction to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck in a line. Against the primary target, the {{as|Sand Soldier's|buzzword2}} attack applies both {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects

mechanics.claim: Commanding a soldier to attack triggers on-attack effects (e.g. proc cooldowns/stacks) but does not apply those effects' outcomes to the target hit.
mechanics.quote: Commanding a soldier to attack will trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but will not apply any of these effects to the target hit.

mechanics.claim: The soldier's attacks do not apply life steal.
mechanics.quote: The attacks do not apply {{sti|life steal}}.

mechanics.claim: Azir periodically stocks a Sand Soldier charge, up to a maximum of 2, independent of casting the spell directly.
mechanics.quote: '''Azir''' periodically [[stock]]s a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}}, up to a maximum of 2.
